subject: OS X CLT v6.3 causes RStan install failure

messages.author: dae01c57a3c54a3a
messages.subject: OS X CLT v6.3 causes RStan install failure
parts:
Related to this, if you upgrade to CLT v6.3 then try to install* RStan, it'll fail. Safest solution is to revert to CLT v6.2, but other solutions are posted at the aforelinked stackoverflow post.

* --> My memory is fuzzy, but I might have even had RStan installed and working, then updated CLT, then tried to build a Stan model and encountered errors. But for sure trying a clean RStan with CLT v6.3 will fail.
